_comment: Update manifest for the Powenetics V2/V3 desktop apps. Served raw over HTTPS from this public repo so the in-app updater can read it anonymously (the app source repos are private). PresentMon is intentionally NOT listed - it comes straight from Intel's public GameTechDev/PresentMon releases API. Every url MUST be https; the app rejects plain HTTP, rejects any download whose sha256 does not match, and additionally requires a valid Authenticode signature for RTSS (MICRO-STAR INTERNATIONAL). Entries below are seeded to the versions currently shipping, so a check reports 'up to date' until you publish something newer.

rtss.notes: RTSS 7.3.5.28314 - the runtime bundled with and vetted against Powenetics.

powenetics-v2.notes: PMD auto-find no longer opens Bluetooth serial ports, tries the board's USB id first, and wakes an idle board the same way Open does (respects Calibration Mode).

powenetics-v3.notes: Powenetics V3 is not publicly released yet. This entry deliberately carries no url or sha256; it will be filled in with the first public V3 build.

pcue.notes: pCUE installer. Unlike the Powenetics repos, crmaris/pCUE is PUBLIC, so its release assets are hosted there rather than here. Build with build/pack-release.ps1 (it prints version + sha256), attach the setup .exe to a Release on crmaris/pCUE, then update this entry.

win11perfwidget.notes: RAM Usage and VRAM Usage side by side, with independent percentages and used/total GB. Existing memory tile settings and position are preserved; no optional GPU tile needed. Signed installer hosted publicly because the source is private.

fanrpmcontrol.notes: One update button: the banner checks when nothing is pending and installs (SHA-256 verified, confirmed) when an update is available. Polarity interlock removed, CLI discover + SSE streaming, .NET 10 throughout.
